tool_def_run_js.message: Execute general JavaScript in the main world of the current page. Can be used to read DOM, query page data, click elements, modify content, inject CSS, adjust page layout, call page scripts, and supports await. When the user asks to modify, rearrange, apply styles, or operate the current page, execute it directly with this tool instead of just providing code or suggestions. The AskPage dialog is extension UI, not page content; do not select, read, modify, or apply styles to #askpage-dialog-host or its shadow DOM, and do not use html/body filter, transform, opacity or other ancestor effects to affect the extension UI. To return a result to the model, use return.
